q1.prompt: Edges have non-negative weights; you need single-source shortest paths. Which engine?

choices.label: Dijkstra — grow the settled set by closest unsettled node
BFS on a plain queue ignoring weights

wrong_bfs.explanation: Non-negative weighted shortest paths need Dijkstra (or similar). Plain BFS treats every edge as weight 1.

q2.prompt: Which input invalidates the proposed shortest-path algorithm?

choices.label: Do not run Dijkstra with negative edges; do not apply undirected MST algorithms to directed graphs
Dijkstra works for every weight sign

wrong_refuse.explanation: Do not run Dijkstra when negative edges exist. Do not apply undirected MST algorithms to directed graphs. Do not pick dense all-pairs Floyd for a single-source sparse query without need.

success.prompt: You matched Dijkstra to non-negative weights and avoided negative-edge misuse.
